verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live, structured llms.txt at help.puzzle.io/llms.txt that indexes the help center. Help articles are also served as .md files, and puzzle.io's own llms.txt links to the ReadMe developer reference, which is backed by a machine-readable OpenAPI document, so an agent has agent-oriented entry points to consume. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent actually consuming these docs, and the generic /en/.md docs-markdown path returns 404 (only individual article .md URLs are evidenced).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://help.puzzle.io/llms.txt # Puzzle Help Center
it is the sync source for the vendor's ReadMe-hosted developer reference (puzzle-api.readme.io, linked from puzzle.io's llms.txt)
